title: Radar
subtitle: Other brands your Radar sources track: what their customers love and hate, what they ship, and how you compare. Kept apart from your own feedback.
notice: Reviews come from your Radar sources; releases come only from web search, with their sources cited.

empty.title: No brand on the Radar yet
empty.body: A Radar source collects reviews of another brand without mixing them into your own numbers.
empty.step1: Open Administration → Sources → Radar and add the brand with its own website domains.
empty.step2: On the Scrapers page, tick "Radar source" on the scraper or review connector that collects its reviews, and choose the brand.
empty.step3: New reviews from that source appear here. Releases appear after the next scan, or press Scan now in Administration → Sources → Radar.

trend.title: Sentiment trend
trend.empty: No reviews in this window yet.

themes.sampled: Read from the newest reviews of this window.

releases.title: News and releases
releases.empty: No news found yet. News and releases come from the scheduled scan or Scan now.
releases.kindEmpty: Nothing of the kind “{{kind}}” in this list. Choose All to see every item.

compare.title: Compared with us
compare.unavailable: Your source access is limited, so your own side of the comparison is not shown.
compare.fewReviews: Few reviews (under {{min, number}}): read with care
compare.openOurs_one: Open our review in {{category}} in Categories
compare.openOurs_other: Open our {{count, number}} reviews in {{category}} in Categories

brands.hint: The brands Radar follows: the news scan searches the web for each one (in its language, and its news feeds if set), and the sources you mark as a Radar source on the Data sources page bring in its reviews.
brands.domainsHint: Comma separated, at most {{max, number}} (for example its site and blog). Used to find its release notes.
brands.removeMessage: Its stored reviews and releases are kept. The release scan stops searching for it, and the scrapers and connectors still set to this brand stop importing until you choose another brand for them. Save the brands to apply.
brands.legacyNote: Named by a source profile ({{sources}}). Saving the brands adds it to the list.
brands.saveFailed: The brands could not be saved.
brands.loadFailed: The brand list could not be loaded.
brands.feedsHint: Optional RSS or Atom feeds of the brand's news. Read at each scan. At most {{max, number}}, one per line or comma separated.
brands.feedsHttps: Each news feed must be an https:// link.
brands.fixFeeds: Fix the news feeds before saving.
brands.searchTermsHint: Optional words or phrases added to the news searches, such as the legal name or product names. Useful when the brand name is also a common word. At most {{max, number}}, one per line, {{chars, number}} characters each.
brands.excludeTermsHint: Optional words or phrases: a search result whose title or snippet contains one is skipped. At most {{max, number}}, one per line, {{chars, number}} characters each.
brands.termsTooLong: Each term can have at most {{chars, number}} characters.
brands.termsInvalid: A term cannot contain double quotes or start with -.
brands.fixTerms: Fix the search or exclude terms before saving.

setup.step1: Add it below, with its own website domains to find its news; optionally its search language and news feeds.
setup.step2: On the Data sources page, tick "Radar source" on a scraper, a Web Reviews page, an app connector or a CSV/JSON import, and choose the brand. Its reviews go to Radar only, never to your dashboards.
setup.step3: A web search for each brand's news (launches, new features, promotions, partnerships, company news), in the brand's language and through its news feeds, runs automatically on the cadence below (checked daily), or now with Scan now. The first scan looks back 90 days.

settings.title: Radar
settings.description: The news scan searches the web for what each Radar brand ships and announces. Nothing runs until a brand is added.
settings.queryCapHint: Shared equally between the brands; each search is billed.
settings.saveFailed: The Radar settings could not be saved.
settings.scanStarted: The scan has started. New releases appear on the Radar page when it ends.
settings.scanFailed: The scan could not be started.
settings.scanNowHint: Searches the web and each brand's own domains for its releases and news now, without waiting for the schedule. It takes a few minutes and uses web searches.

reviews.title: {{brand}} reviews
reviews.loadFailed: The reviews could not be loaded.
reviews.keepLooking: No match in the reviews read so far. Load more to keep looking.

all.brandsCaption: Every tracked brand in this window: its reviews, sentiment, releases and latest news
all.capped: Showing the newest {{shown, number}} of {{total, number}}

exa.title: Exa (second search index)
exa.description: When Radar's web search finds no dated news for a brand, Exa is searched too. Only brand names, search terms and domains are sent to Exa. About $5 per 1,000 searches, billed by Exa.
exa.replacePlaceholder: A key is stored. Paste a new one to replace it
exa.saveFailed: The Exa key could not be saved.
exa.removeFailed: The Exa key could not be removed.
exa.removeMessage: Radar stops searching Exa. Its own web search keeps running, and the news already found is kept.
